description: This image helps the reader understand that best–worst voting, one point for first and minus one for last, can turn sincere rankings back into the approval result: two copies of one ballot approving x and y, ranked x y z and y x z, give x 1, y 1 and z −2, so both approved candidates win.
head: Best–worst voting recovers approval winners
sub: +1 first, −1 last: two copies of ballot {x, y}, ranked x y z and y x z
